reason: An external-services plugin that provides a unified gateway between DeepSeek Harness agents and more than 20 messaging platforms, including session routing, remote approvals, interactive questions, reminders, and file delivery.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 智能体接入微信、飞书、Telegram、Discord 等多个聊天平台，并提供统一会话、远程审批、交互提问和提醒能力。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness agents to WeChat, Feishu, Telegram, Discord, and other chat platforms with unified sessions, remote approvals, interactive questions, reminders, and file delivery.

capabilities: Connects DeepSeek Harness agents to external messaging platforms
Receives and sends chat messages across configured channels
Routes messages to agent sessions and supports session switching
Relays remote approval and interactive question responses
Creates and delivers chat-level scheduled reminders
Sends workspace files to connected chats
